title: Hugging Face's Clem Delangue on Open Source AI and the LLM Bubble | MTS Live

reader_summary.headline: Hugging Face's Clem Delangue discusses open source AI, security, and the future of robotics.
reader_summary.overview: Clem Delangue argues that restricting AI capabilities hinders progress and that open access helps defenders fight bad actors. He notes that while the US moved toward closed systems, China currently leads in open source models. Hugging Face supports both public and private model usage to meet different security needs.

notes: Clem Delangue joins MTS to discuss the global open-source AI landscape, the current large language model bubble, and the future of consumer robotics. Originally aired on MTS, Theo Jaffee and Sofia Puccini speak with Clément Delangue, CEO at Hugging Face, about the global open-source AI race, why he believes the real bubble is in API-based large language models, and how robotics could become the next major interface for AI. They also discuss AI safety, U.S.-China competition, open-weight models, and why Hugging Face became the infrastructure layer for open AI development.
